tagline: Building hands-on aerospace, robotics, and astronomy projects through design, manufacturing, and research.
description: Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering student at the University at Buffalo focused on digital manufacturing, space systems, robotics, astronomy education, and hands-on engineering mentorship.

roles.detailed: Aerospace & Mechanical Engineering | Digital Manufacturing | Space Research

location.availability: Open to internships and research roles

bio: Bachelor of Science candidate in Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering at the University at Buffalo, anticipated June 2029. Experienced across digital manufacturing, 3D printing, CAD workshops, microcontroller programming, robotics, astronomy education, and aerospace research. I have trained 500+ students on fabrication tools, supported 3D printing lab operations, contributed to orbital debris simulations and SWARM drone motion capture research, and built astronomy and space education projects using ESP32, Python, MATLAB, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, and ROS 2.

bullets: Organized and facilitated hands-on workshops covering SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Revit, and Altium PCB Designer.
Trained and mentored 500+ students in 3D printing techniques using Prusa MK4S and MK3S printers.
Trained students to operate the U-Factory 6-axis robotic arm and supported Arduino microcontroller programming.
experience.desc: Hands-on engineering lab role focused on workshops, 3D printing mentorship, robotics training, and technical support for students.

experience.company: Digital Manufacturing Lab, University at Buffalo
bullets: Managed day-to-day Digital Manufacturing Laboratory operations and coordinated 3D printing workflows.
Operated and maintained SLA and FDM 3D printers, including post-processing and user training.
Collaborated with students, faculty, staff, and industry partners to fulfill 3D printing work orders.
Reduced material wastage by 20% through efficient design guidance, printer selection, and material optimization.
experience.desc: Digital manufacturing lab operations, additive manufacturing support, print consultation, and workflow optimization.

experience.company: Autodesk Design and Make, University at Buffalo
bullets: Organized and led Tinkercad and Fusion 360 workshops for students and educators.
Promoted hands-on learning through 3D design, prototyping, and engineering challenges.
Supported peer learning through online sessions, demo projects, and one-on-one guidance.
Developed DIY interactive kits for students using 3D printing and basic materials.
experience.desc: Autodesk student ambassador role centered on 3D design education, prototyping, and student-facing workshops.

bullets: Conducted orbital debris tracking simulations using MATLAB and Python, improving system accuracy by 15%.
Tested debris mesh capturing methods using TurtleBots and ROS 2.
Developed an autonomous SWARM drone motion capture system.
experience.desc: Aerospace research role focused on orbital debris tracking, robotics, ROS 2, and autonomous drone motion capture.

bullets: Designed and tested 5+ astronomy-based educational models, improving student engagement by 30%.
Developed 2+ prototype projects using ESP32 and IoT.
Updated curriculum with simulations and DIY kits built through 3D printing.
Designed 45+ weekly newsletters and developed email automation and staff management tools.
experience.desc: Space education and prototype development role spanning astronomy models, ESP32 projects, curriculum, newsletters, and automation.

bullets: Conducted 50+ workshops introducing high school students and teachers to telescopic observations.
Organized 5+ overnight sky-gazing activities with a team of five.
Assisted in rocket nozzle design and simulation using Ansys with a 45-member team.
Conducted structural and thermal analysis for high-temperature material durability.
experience.desc: Astronomy education and aerospace internship experience across workshops, sky-gazing programs, rocket nozzle simulation, and analysis.

projects.title: Exoclock Unlocked
projects.subtitle: Exoplanet Observation and Light Curve Analysis
projects.desc: Scheduled 50+ exoplanet observations for TOI 4308 in collaboration with the European Space Agency and UCL. Analyzed Las Cumbres Observatory data, generated and cleaned light curves, detected exoplanet transits, refined orbital parameters, and interpreted transit timing variations.

projects.title: Variable Stars in Open Clusters
projects.subtitle: CCD Photometry and Variable Star Classification
projects.desc: Investigated stellar variability using CCD photometric analysis. Built light curves to identify and classify known and unknown variable stars within open clusters and reported observations to the American Association of Variable Star Observers.

projects.title: Chandrayaan Working Model
projects.subtitle: ESP32-Based Interactive Mission Demonstrator
projects.desc: Created an ESP32 working model to demonstrate ISRO Chandrayaan mission concepts, integrating web server control for interactive live demonstrations and classroom-ready learning experiences.
